---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change that serves the drift-detection workflow
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What is hard or missing today. Describe it from the user's side, with a
concrete example if there is one.

## Proposed behavior

What should happen instead, and which tool or service it touches
(`src/tools/` adapter or `src/services/` logic).

## Alternatives considered

What else would solve the problem, and why the proposal above fits better.
Workarounds with the current tools count.

## Scope

What is in scope for this request, and what is explicitly out of scope.
One request per issue: if the idea splits into independent changes, file
them separately.
